name: retire-v2-back-compat-aliases
title: Retire the v2 back-compat read aliases
description: Retire the Type Overlay v2 back-compat aliases from the general read paths (candidateTypeInstances / normalizeTypeDefsValue) so no new dependency on the old keys can form, while keeping a dedicated alias pass on the legacy one-time migration inputs (pre-rename firmware_profiles trees, per-dir profile.json, Memento-era arrays) so those stay lossless. Updates the alias tests to the narrowed contract and the storage spec's back-compat window.
creator: deviousprophet
